body: The first-aid kit and water bottle share sticky pollen from the seed trial. They were bundled before the county van arrived.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle, monday morning
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same sticky pollen while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body: A pencil and map share the same pocket. One route is marked toward the road, then overwritten with a line back toward the building.
title: An exit marked twice
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
